title: Vizor — AI-assisted Tableau Workbook Reviewer
summary: A Python MCP tool that reviews Tableau workbooks, surfaces confidence-scored observations about dashboards and worksheets, and applies safe automated edits while keeping the file valid.
problem: Tableau workbooks accumulate unclear worksheet names, stale identity metadata, and inconsistent dashboards. Reviewing and cleaning them up by hand is slow, easy to get wrong, and hard to do consistently across many files.
approach: Built a Python MCP server that parses .twb XML into a structured model, generates honest, confidence-scored observations about the workbook (dashboard type, detected worksheets), and proposes or applies safe, deterministic edits — renaming worksheets to describe what they show and refreshing workbook identity metadata — while guaranteeing the file stays valid Tableau XML. Deterministic scoring means the same input always produces the same result, and edited workbooks are re-parsed in tests to prove they still open.
outcome: Turned manual workbook cleanup into a repeatable, reviewable flow: observations carry explicit confidence signals so a human stays in control, and every automated edit preserves a valid, reopenable workbook.
